text: At its meeting on May 24, 2017, City Council adopted the College Street Site and Specific Policy Official Plan Amendment ("OPA 379"), which was the recommended Official Plan Amendment resulting from the College Street Study (the "Study"). The Study reviewed the policy context for College Street (generally from University Avenue to Bathurst Street) (the "Study Area') to address land use and the inclusion of institutional uses within mixed-use buildings; building scale and height; and public realm, including special places and pedestrian improvements. OPA 379 clarifies the expectations for the built form for new developments falling within the Study Area.
